tier_definitions.SUPPORTED_EXPLORATORY: Numerically supported in this dataset; not confirmatory and not generalized.
tier_definitions.LIMITED: Supported only under stated constraints, or a descriptive/archive fact bounded to this material.
tier_definitions.UNSUPPORTED: The available evidence does not establish the claim.
tier_definitions.INVALIDATED: The claim is contradicted by the audit evidence.
tier_definitions.NOT_EVALUABLE: The required data or design is absent.

effect_size_context.note: The energy effect is small (dz 0.27); the mean-MSE effect is negligible (dz 0.04). B5's 95% coverage is 0.725 versus B3's 0.938, so the energy contrast is partly a spread/calibration contrast.

claims.claim: The analysed file is Kato WT_NoStim with SHA256 matching the OSF object.
claims.why: Direct hash and byte-size verification; tier vocabulary has no VERIFIED label, so LIMITED means bounded to the archive, not uncertain.

claims.claim: Five recordings contain 15,662 frames and 592 behaviour-label-excluded predictors in total.
claims.why: Direct HDF5 count; predictor count excludes eight label-defining neuron names.

claims.claim: The five entries are five distinct animals, not five repeated sessions of one preparation.
claims.why: Publication and secondary descriptions report five worms; OSF has no animal key. One acquisition per animal is inferred, not keyed. They are one laboratory cohort, not independent replication.

claims.claim: The eight behaviour labels are independent external measurements.
claims.why: Labels derive from command/interneuron calcium and behaviour; they are not independent of the recorded brain.

claims.claim: There are 35 H100 test landmarks in every recording.
claims.why: Actual counts are 35, 35, 34, 38, 33 (175 total).

claims.claim: All recordings share the test boundary 2689:3137.
claims.why: 2689:3137 is session 0 only; the code uses per-recording boundaries.

claims.claim: Every reported forecast target lies inside its recording and inside the test mask, with no padding or interpolation.
claims.why: Verified for H1-H100; H=5 session 1 reaches the last observed frame with zero margin but is valid.

claims.claim: B3 has lower H20 PCA-10 energy than B5-10 in the frozen 175-landmark sample.
claims.why: Mean +0.2644, block-5 conditional interval [+0.0750, +0.4031], 64% of landmarks positive; numerical reproduction passes.

claims.claim: B3 is better in four of five recordings.
claims.why: Session means +0.300, +0.329, -0.193, +0.407, +0.465; session 2 reverses.

claims.claim: The B3 advantage generalizes across animals.
claims.why: Recording-level t interval [-0.064, +0.587] includes zero; one-sided sign test p=0.1875; five units.

claims.claim: B3 improves the conditional mean forecast.
claims.why: PCA-10 MSE +0.0545 with block-5 interval [-0.157, +0.241]; neuron MSE -0.0354 with interval crossing zero.

claims.claim: The B3 advantage is uniform across horizons and recordings.
claims.why: H1 reverses (-0.0637; B5 better), H5/H10/H20 are positive, session 2 reverses.

claims.claim: The 51% common / 49% residual split is a unique structural partition.
claims.why: It is an ordered B4m->B5->B3 decomposition; B1m gives 23.5/76.5 and B0 gives 72.4/27.6.

claims.claim: The fitted off-diagonal operator identifies stable direct neuron-neuron interactions.
claims.why: Off-diagonal cross-segment correlation 0.052; G3 fails; common-input synthetic confound.

claims.claim: A named-neuron virtual perturbation predicts a biological intervention.
claims.why: Model-dependent +1 SD displacement; cross-fit response cosine 0.556; no matched intervention data.

claims.claim: The ensemble is probabilistically calibrated.
claims.why: B5 95% coverage is 0.725; B3 is 0.938 but calibration was not established in prior calibration audits.

claims.claim: G4 is a fully prespecified confirmatory PASS.
claims.why: The sign rule was clarified in the same commit as the results; numerical pass under corrected sign, confirmatory status NOT_ESTABLISHED.

claims.claim: The residual B3 advantage is information rather than estimator capacity.
claims.why: B3 has 7.96-9.95x more parameters and arbitrary residual coordinates; no capacity-matched restricted model was prespecified.

claims.claim: B5 undercoverage is a sufficient explanation of the energy advantage.
claims.why: Coverage 0.725 vs 0.938 and negligible MSE effect make it plausible, but no decomposition of energy into calibration and resolution establishes sufficiency.

claims.claim: The Kato test tails were untouched before the final audit.
claims.why: Earlier phases inspected the same test block; the final audit is an exploratory reanalysis.

claims.claim: Test frames are touched once, only for final metrics.
claims.why: B3/B5 are refit at every landmark on all transitions before t, including validation and earlier test frames. No future leakage, but the estimand is online-refit forecasting.

claims.claim: The reported 95% coverage is joint 10-D calibration.
claims.why: coverage_95 is the average of marginal per-dimension interval coverage, not joint ellipsoid coverage.

claims.claim: The result is ready for confirmatory publication or biological interpretation.
claims.why: Exploratory, one reused cohort, animal-level interval includes zero, calibration/capacity confounds, no intervention.
